tools.name: document_search
tools.description: Semantic search inside ONE uploaded document file (Workspace file_id). Supported files: PDF (.pdf), Word (.docx/.doc), Excel (.xlsx/.xls/.csv), PowerPoint (.pptx/.ppt), and text/data (.txt/.md/.html/.json/.xml). The file is converted to organized markdown via MarkItDown, split into 300-word chunks, and embedded — scanned PDF pages with almost no text are transcribed by the vision model first. Call with the Workspace file_id (e.g. report.pdf), a query sentence to compare, and how many chunks to return (top_k, min 1). The file_id MUST be a supported type or the call is rejected — check the Workspace block or list first.

tools.name: file_to_base64

Reference the saved path in later tool calls (or read it in pieces with read_file) — never paste the base64 text into the chat.

tools.name: pdf_studio
tools.description: Manage PDF Studios in ONE tool (action=create|open|list|get, default create). Studios are never auto-listed in context — call action=list first to see EVERY studio with its state (id/title/pages/designed/orientation/open_url), or action=get with a studio_id for one studio's full details (slide states, orientation, assets). Create: call once with the studio title and the reason — ONLY when every listed studio already has designs. You may also pass pages: up to 10 short page descriptions taken from what the user said they want inside the PDF (one per slide) — the studio is created at once and every page design starts immediately in parallel in the background, so the user opens it and finds the designs already generating. Omit pages when the user did not specify the PDF content (empty studio, they drive it from inside). Open: call with the studio_id of a listed studio (prefer one with 0 designed) to hand it back instead of creating. Then end your reply with the Open Studio card ([STUDIO:pdf_N]) on its own line plus the studio link line (open_url) right after it, so gateway chats get the link as text. It only returns studio_id plus open_url — everything else happens later inside the studio itself.

Create: call once with the studio title and the reason — ONLY when every listed studio already has designs. You may also pass pages: up to 10 short page descriptions taken from what the user said they want inside the PDF (one per slide) — the studio is created at once and every page design starts immediately in parallel in the background, so the user opens it and finds the designs already generating. tools.description: A workspace file locator tool that searches INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only (any path outside is BLOCKED) for file paths matching glob patterns or content queries. Use whenever you need to locate workspace files, examine workspace layouts, or find code references across workspace folders. Use this to pinpoint exact target paths before reading or editing files.

tools.name: show_preview
tools.description: Show the browser to the user in the floating watch-only preview window (no control handed over) and answer its link. Call it when the user should watch what you are doing. Idempotent: if that same preview is already on screen nothing reopens.

tools.name: svg_maker
tools.description: THE ONLY WAY to create SVG icons or vector logos. Call this tool DIRECTLY (via tool_search) the moment the user asks for an svg, icon, or vector logo — never hand-write SVG manually with other tools. Takes a plain description of the wanted image (what it shows, style, colors) and returns RAW SVG CODE ONLY plus the saved .svg file in Workspace. The tool owns an internal single-shot session with its own icon system prompt (simple 24x24 icon basics); the same text model draws the icon and the tool validates it. Output is the svg code as-is.

spec.name: svg_maker
spec.description: THE ONLY WAY to create SVG icons or vector logos. Call this tool DIRECTLY (via tool_search) the moment the user asks for an svg, icon, or vector logo — never hand-write SVG manually with other tools. Takes a plain description of the wanted image (what it shows, style, colors) and returns RAW SVG CODE ONLY plus the saved .svg file in Workspace. The tool owns an internal single-shot session with its own icon system prompt (simple 24x24 icon basics); the same text model draws the icon and the tool validates it. Output is the svg code as-is.

description.description: What the icon shows (subject, style, colors). 1..2000 chars, e.g. 'blue outline shopping cart icon'.

icon_name.description: File base name for the saved .svg in Workspace (letters, numbers, _ -; default derived from description).

size.description: Width/height in px, 16..512 (default 48). Sets width/height on the svg root.

tools.name: text_to_speech
tools.description: A text-to-speech tool that converts written text into a spoken wav voice recording using the local Supertonic-3 model with the project's single fixed custom voice (a deep, calm, JARVIS-like male voice that sounds the same in Arabic + English, no cloud). Use whenever the user asks to hear text read aloud or wants a voice message. Saves the wav under X5Agent/Data/files/audio and returns its path plus duration so it plays as a WhatsApp-style voice record inside the chat. Keep text short (one message, max 1000 chars).

spec.name: text_to_speech

Use whenever the user asks to hear text read aloud or wants a voice message. Saves the wav under X5Agent/Data/files/audio and returns its path plus duration so it plays as a WhatsApp-style voice record inside the chat. Keep text short (one message, max 1000 chars).

voice.description: Fixed project voice (nova). The voice is always the same; any other value is ignored.

tools.name: upload_files
tools.description: Attach one or more workspace files to a file field without opening the OS picker. Paths outside the workspace fail with path_forbidden. Needs human approval first when approvals are on.

tools.name: video_analyze
tools.description: Video understanding via the connected AI Vision Videos model (AI Models template 'AI Vision Videos') — sends the video bytes themselves, never still-image frames. Use whenever a video file requires visual content analysis. Refuses with the model link when no Vision Videos model is connected; it never uses the images model.

spec.name: video_analyze
spec.description: Video understanding via the connected AI Vision Videos model (AI Models template 'AI Vision Videos') — sends the video bytes themselves, never still-image frames. Use whenever a video file requires visual content analysis. Refuses with the model link when no Vision Videos model is connected; it never uses the images model.

job_id.description: Job ID to poll status. If provided, returns job status.

tools.name: video_download
tools.description: A video download tool that fetches a public video from a URL (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and hundreds of sites via yt-dlp) and saves the mp4 file INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only. Use whenever the user gives a video link that must be analyzed. Returns the saved workspace path plus video metadata (title, uploader, duration, resolution) so the next step can call video_analyze or video_transcribe on the saved file.

spec.name: video_download
spec.description: A video download tool that fetches a public video from a URL (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and hundreds of sites via yt-dlp) and saves the mp4 file INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only. Use whenever the user gives a video link that must be analyzed. Returns the saved workspace path plus video metadata (title, uploader, duration, resolution) so the next step can call video_analyze or video_transcribe on the saved file.

url.description: Public video page URL (http(s) only, e.g. TikTok/YouTube/Instagram link).

filename.description: Optional custom file name inside Workspace (single name, .mp4 added if missing).

tools.name: video_transcribe
tools.description: An asynchronous speech transcription tool that extracts audio from video files and transcribes speech into timestamped text. Use whenever a video contains spoken dialogue, interviews, or lectures that need verbatim transcription. Use this to extract accurate chronological dialogue and spoken facts from media files.

spec.name: video_transcribe
spec.description: An asynchronous speech transcription tool that extracts audio from video files and transcribes speech into timestamped text. Use whenever a video contains spoken dialogue, interviews, or lectures that need verbatim transcription. Use this to extract accurate chronological dialogue and spoken facts from media files.

job_id.description: Job ID to poll status. If provided, returns job status.

language.description: Language hint for transcription, e.g. ar, en. Default auto.

tools.name: vision_analyze
tools.description: Still-image inspection via the connected AI Vision Model (images only — videos go through video_analyze with the AI Vision Videos model). Use for photos, receipts, diagrams, UI mockups. Grounded visual reasoning without terminal workarounds.

spec.name: vision_analyze
spec.description: Still-image inspection via the connected AI Vision Model (images only — videos go through video_analyze with the AI Vision Videos model). Use for photos, receipts, diagrams, UI mockups. Grounded visual reasoning without terminal workarounds.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until one condition holds before continuing (spinner, late load, result appearing). On timeout returns the timeout plus the current page state.

spec.name: wait_for
spec.description: Wait until one condition holds before continuing (spinner, late load, result appearing). On timeout returns the timeout plus the current page state.

condition.description: text, text_gone, element_visible, element_hidden, url_contains, network_idle, new_tab, download_complete, console_message or seconds.

value.description: Value for the condition (text, url part, seconds count).

tools.name: workspace
tools.description: Your work device: list folders/files and create folders INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only. The context shows only the top level (folders as folder/ with item counts); call list with a folder path to enter it before reading anything inside. Every file, upload, or project lives inside Workspace — one new folder per project or task. Paths outside Workspace are BLOCKED.

spec.name: workspace
spec.description: Your work device: list folders/files and create folders INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only. The context shows only the top level (folders as folder/ with item counts); call list with a folder path to enter it before reading anything inside. Every file, upload, or project lives inside Workspace — one new folder per project or task. Paths outside Workspace are BLOCKED.

action.description: list: show one folder level. create_folder: make a new folder. delete_file: delete one file (also deletes its document embeddings).

path.description: Workspace-relative folder to list or create inside. Empty means the Workspace root.

name.description: Folder name for create_folder, or file name for delete_file.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: A filesystem modification tool that creates new files or replaces existing file contents INSIDE X5Agent/Workspace only (any path outside is BLOCKED, but anything inside is open). Use whenever you need to write code, save generated reports, update configs, or store structured data on disk. Use this to implement concrete changes and persist verified outputs in the workspace.
